title: Blood Pressure Out-of-Range Log
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings measurements (`withings:measure`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export or Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=withings:measure metric=blood_pressure
| eval flag=case(systolic>=140 OR diastolic>=90,"high",systolic<90 OR diastolic<60,"low",1=1,"normal")
| where flag!="normal"
| table _time systolic diastolic flag
| sort - _time
description: Keeps a running log of every blood-pressure reading that falls outside the normal range, ready to show a doctor.
value: An automatically curated out-of-range log is far more useful at a check-up than a memory of 'it was high sometimes'.
implementation: Ingest home blood-pressure readings; schedule daily and export the out-of-range log ahead of medical appointments.
visualization: Table of out-of-range readings over time with high/low flags.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a tidy list of the times your blood pressure was too high or low, which is handy to show your doctor.
